**Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted** is a healthcare clinic operating within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] in Denmark. It is one of the institutional units evaluated in the national annual reports for the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark), which is coordinated by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to monitor and benchmark cardiovascular healthcare quality across the country [^src2] [^src4].

The clinic is specifically highlighted for its high performance in meeting national clinical quality standards. During the reporting period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the clinic was measured against [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which tracks the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who receive an echocardiography. Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted achieved a compliance rate of 98.8% (95% CI: 93.6–100.0), successfully meeting the national standard [^src2]. 

Additionally, the clinic's long-term treatment efficacy is monitored under [[indikator-4a|Indikator 4a]], which evaluates anticoagulation treatment coverage. In the 5-year analysis for this indicator, the clinic recorded a 100.0% (95% CI: 86.8–100.0) compliance rate [^src4]. The clinic's statistical data, including patient denominators and confidence intervals, is consistently documented across multiple sections of the RKKP's comprehensive hospital-level and regional analyses [^src1] [^src3] [^src5].
